trap.label: presente × present perfect continuous
trap.wrong: How long are you waiting here?
trap.right: How long have you been waiting here?
trap.why: Em português “há quanto tempo você espera aqui?” usa o presente. Em inglês, ação em andamento desde o passado usa have been + -ing.

fix.right: I have been studying English since 2020.

fix.wrong: He has been wait for hours.
fix.right: He has been waiting for hours.

fix.wrong: We have been cook since noon.
fix.right: We have been cooking since noon.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “I cook. I started two hours ago.” (for)
rewrite.answer: I have been cooking for two hours.
